items.title: Pierre Boussaguet interviewed by Matthieu Jaffre, Aix en Provence, France, July 28, 2020
items.q: [(note)] Pierre was interviewed in Aix en Provence, France on 7/28/2020 by Matthieu Jaffre.

ctx.x: Bassist Pierre Boussaguet was born in Albi, France in 1962. He has recorded and performed with the best jazz artists from both America and Europe, including Lalo Schifrin, Ray Brown and Guy Lafitte.
Pierre was interviewed in Aix en Provence, France on 7/28/2020 by Matthieu Jaffre.

Hello. We are here today at the Fola Jazz Club in Aix en Provence in the south of France. We are filming for Fillius Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m delighted today to welcome Pierre Boussaguet. Pierre Boussaguet, hello. How are you doing?
